inventory_rationale: The function inventory is the accepted Factory spec's (sha256 459ac96c4b8febc629c81178c9d0a84ee072d1662dc52f44d74fb0993cb3c2c7, Factory 6011ac93b143): every contract, its owning module from module_functions, in function_order and then the method contracts in their accepted order. Public functions are the 108 State 5 operations; the 49 table route handlers of rules.http_router_backend carry their delegate as router operation; the other functions are the accepted internal, class and interface-method contracts. Owner 2026-11-06: current service behaviour accepted; technical decisions delegated.
